exact_identity_gate.reason: The retained Thonk DW2 drawing title block names 2MS3T1B1M2QES-5, while the handoff names 2MS3T1B1M2QES without suffix. The family catalog lists the unsuffixed MPN but does not establish -5 interchangeability.
exact_identity_gate.evidence_needed: Manufacturer part-number suffix key or exact unsuffixed drawing establishing terminal pattern, bushing, lever, nut and panel hole; alternatively select/order the drawn -5 variant explicitly after owner review.
exact_identity_gate.consequence: Three-position footprint and stack dimensions are provisional; do not qualify the board from these drawings alone.
